intro: Across 17 articles dated 14 April to 15 September 2026, ZCyberNews tracked activity tied to Anthropic, with Claude Mythos and Midnight Blizzard among the most-covered threat actors. Reporting spanned technology, cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, government, and ai-development, and reached China, the Global sphere, the United states, Europe, and Five eyes. The severity mix comprised 6 high, 3 informational, 3 critical, and 1 medium. Claude Mythos and Midnight Blizzard feature as distinct subjects in this archive.
